scores.rationale: The candidate correctly accumulates token usage across tool rounds while ignoring rounds without usage and preserving `undefined` when no usage is reported at all. It satisfies all acceptance criteria—actually following the 'two tool rounds' criterion more literally than the reference by testing three provider calls instead of two. To make the signature unambiguous, the candidate renames the parameter to `totalUsage` (matching the reference) and also introduces a `TurnUsageTotal` type alias and JSDoc. Minor differences from the reference include placing the new tests in a separate acceptance test file rather than `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, leaving the new behaviour in the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section of `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` instead of moving it to the main spec list, and not updating `CLAUDE.md` or `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`.
